notes.title: Added Linux Support
notes.content: In this release we've added Linux to the build pipeline and release process.

notes.title: Update note for May 28
notes.content:
A few minor ug fixes:

[list]
[*]Bug fix for FFB rumble command when out of ammo
[*]Small bug fix to release FFB control when game exits
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for May 24
notes.content: This release of Shooting Gallery provides improved support for gamepad mode with the latest firmware release 1.0.16.

notes.title: Update notes for May 11
notes.content:
For Mother's Day, a couple of changes we've been working on in this update.
[list]
[*] Support for playing Blamcon when in gamepad mode**
[*] Gamepad mode includes force feedback for better game play experience**
[*] New Start Menu so you can get setup before game starts
[/list]

** If using Blamcon lightguns, the latest firmware release 1.0.15 is required for these to work properly.

notes.title: May 11 - Cursor Tracking Updated
notes.content: Fixed a bug report of inaccurate crosshair tracking on multi-monitor displays with irregular aspect ratios. Hopefully this fix will do the trick.
